died: c. 220 (exact date uncertain; not verified in a source read)
role_place: Latin Christian apologist and polemicist at Carthage; Catholic in the early works, Montanist (New Prophecy) in the later ones.
why_relevant: The main Latin apologist and polemicist of the 2nd-3rd century: his own works give the clearest early evidence on persecution (To Scapula 2; Apology 24 and 28), on the Law and the Gospel (Against Marcion; Answer to the Jews 3; Veiling of Virgins 1), and he cites Hebrews (as Barnabas) in On Modesty 20 but never Heb 10:28 in the works read.
